results.title: Stripe, FedEx team on SMB lending | Payments Dive
results.content: Stripe is partnering with global shipping giant FedEx to combine their data insights from logistics and financial infrastructure to create financing options for small businesses, the companies said Tuesday in a joint press release. [...] “Stripe will be better positioned to evaluate, approve, and deploy tailored funding more quickly than traditional lending processes, eliminating the friction for SMBs,” the release said. Stripe makes business loans through two partner banks. [...] The FedEx effort follows Stripe’s purchase last week of embedded financing company Parafin, which also arranges loans for small businesses. Stripe plans to use the San Francisco-based startup to expand its lending for smaller firms. In the Sept. 30 news release about the Parafin acquisition, Stripe argued that small businesses are finding it difficult to access capital, citing a decreasing percentage of approved loans last year compared to 2015.

results.title: Falcons' viral stripes will appear down center of helmets - ESPN
results.content:
The presentation of the retro logo on top of the vertical striping in those colors on that specific social media post seems to be the object of controversy. The stripes will appear down the middle of the team's red helmet and not behind the logo like the graphic showed.

The Falcons declined to comment on the situation. An NFL spokesperson did not immediately respond to a request for comment from The Associated Press. [...] The post featured the franchise's throwback black-and-white bird logo, which it used from the 1960s all the way up to the early 2000s. Behind the logo were vertical stripes in red, black and gold. The colors are a reference to the team's 1966 uniform, which consisted of a red helmet, the black Falcons logo, and black, white and gold striping on the pants. [...] The Falcons have worn the retro logo for games every year since 2009 with the exception of several years when the NFL prevented teams from using an alternative helmet color. Atlanta will wear the logo Sunday when it hosts the San Francisco 49ers at Mercedes-Benz Stadium.
